snippet.title: Gone Digging | Co-op Digging thriller Trailer (1–4 Players)
snippet.description:
Grab a shovel. Trust your friends. Pay the price before nightfall.

Gone Digging is a 1–4 player co-op digging thriller/simulation where you dig deep during the day to collect valuable loot, trade with a merchant, and upgrade your tools. When night falls, an unseen evil demands a sacrifice — fail to satisfy it, and something hunts you down.

🔹 Dig together by day
🔹 Trade loot & upgrade tools
🔹 Offer sacrifices to delay the darkness
🔹 Survive the night… or don’t

🚧 The game is not playable yet. A demo is planned for the future.

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247230/GONE_DIGGING/
👉 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/u3YwAmF2cY
Follow development, share feedback, and be there when the demo drops.

#steamgames #digginggame #thrillerstory #coopgaming #mining
